github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr: This is a Java Gradle multi-module project: core (simulation/physics/ECS/world), client (playable entry point), server (scaffold).
Data contracts in data/ are canonical. Never hardcode narrative IDs, flag keys, plateau IDs, quest IDs, or area names.
ECS components extend Component. Follow existing patterns in core.ecs.components (TransformComponent, HealthComponent, AIComponent).
All progression logic must respect story_flags.json, plateaus.json, and narrative_beats.json as source of truth.
core must not import from client or server. Input and rendering belong in client only.
Regression tests go in RegressionTest.java following the existing labelled-section pattern with pass/fail counters.
Save files use SAVE_V2 envelope format. Migration logic lives in SaveMigrationMatrix.java.
Gradle task names follow verb+noun pattern: runRegressionTests, runWorldgenDiagnostics, runDataContractDiagnostics.
